edge_players.edge_sentence: JSN is the offense at 12 targets and 135 receiving yards a game, and he is aimed at the spot LAC has bled — 9.47 YPA on the left and 9 gains of 20+ — so 93.5 is light even if this is only his third-best game of the month.
edge_players.must_be_true: He stays active on a full route share near his 36 targets over 3 games, LAC keeps bleeding outside/explosive plays, and SEA does not spend the whole second half in a three-back clock kill. Health and inactives are not in the pack.
edge_players.kills_it: SEA gets up big and Wilson, Price and Holani soak the second half before JSN reaches the mid-90s, or LAC brackets him and Shaheed (12 targets) plus Kupp (10) take the explosives.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Johnston has turned 171 air yards into 64 receiving yards, about 21 a game, and SEA has allowed 2 passes of 20+ on 99 attempts with no area above 5.78 YPA, so 34.5 asks for a spike this defense has not been giving.
edge_players.must_be_true: SEA's explosive suppression holds (2 of 99) and he stays near 5.7 targets a game instead of a chase-script spike. No snap-limit news in the pack.
edge_players.kills_it: One 35-plus yard catch, the play missing from his 17 targets, or a pass-heavy LAC chase that doubles his routes against a defense that only blitzes 20%.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and this lost because the missing spread was a SEA blowout: Wilson, Price and Holani ran the clock, JSN finished in the 70s on a cut route share, and Johnston finally hit the one 40-yarder SEA has mostly denied (2 of 99), clearing 34.5 on a single play. The other miss is sample noise — LAC's 9.47 YPA on the left is 38 attempts over 3 games, and SEA's 2 explosives may not travel — so a normal LAC pass day plus a clock-kill would beat both legs at once.
slip_story: One story only: SEA's pass game attacks a leaky LAC secondary while SEA's defense erases LAC's unsuccessful deep shots. JSN over 93.5 is the anchor; Johnston under 34.5 is the same-game defensive correlate. Not a shootout stack. Do not add McConkey over 46.5 or Harris over 35.5 (those need the flip where LAC air yards land) or Hampton over 45.5 (needs a LAC run script that can fight SEA control, and SEA allows only 3.37 YPC). Two legs, one market per player, no TDs.
